connections.name: Azure Developer CLI
connections.reason: Provision the Automation Account and supporting resources.

connections.name: Azure CLI
connections.reason: Run interactive ARM, Graph, Exchange, Entra role, Azure RBAC, and cleanup hooks. Redeployment can remove an existing Automation Account delete lock and replace all its job schedules. Read checks do not prove authority to make these changes.

groups.title: Maester coverage
groups.description: The raw template defaults the dashboard, Exchange, Teams, and Azure integrations to off. This wizard writes guided choices: Exchange, Teams, and Azure on, dashboard off, with the Extended permission profile. Turning a deployed feature off is additive: it does not remove earlier resources or assignments and can overwrite their tracked cleanup IDs. Run teardown before disabling a feature, or independently discover and remove the residual changes. Review each choice or apply Minimal pilot below.

fields.label: Include secured web dashboard
fields.help: Adds an App Service dashboard and creates or updates its Easy Auth Entra application and service principal. Grants all-principals delegated consent for openid, profile, email, and User.Read. The selected security group gates access. Review the App Service SKU and ongoing cost before enabling.

fields.label: Include Exchange checks
fields.help: Grants Exchange.ManageAsApp and attempts a best-effort Exchange View-Only Configuration role assignment. Setup requires ExchangeOnlineManagement on this computer; the Automation runtime module is deployed even when these checks are off. Automated teardown does not guarantee cleanup of Exchange service-principal and role assignments; review them separately.

fields.label: Include Teams checks
fields.help: Assigns the Entra Teams Reader role to the automation identity.

fields.label: Include Azure checks
fields.help: Assigns Azure Reader to the automation identity at each configured scope, or the selected subscription when scopes are blank. A management-group scope extends read access across its descendant subscriptions; choose the narrowest scope needed.

fields.label: Allowed security group
fields.help: Object ID of the Entra security group allowed through App Service Easy Auth.

fields.label: App Service SKU
fields.help: F1 is the Free tier with shared capacity and limits. Choosing a paid App Service SKU adds ongoing cost; check regional availability and pricing before deployment.

fields.label: Mail recipient
fields.help: Optional recipient for Maester email notifications. Providing a recipient also grants Microsoft Graph Mail.Send to the automation identity.

fields.label: Permission profile
fields.help: Minimal grants eight baseline Graph application read roles to the automation identity and still makes directory permission assignments. Extended adds eleven application roles for device, security, SharePoint, and hunting coverage. Neither profile is a read-only setup; review directory changes before deployment.

fields.label: Azure RBAC scopes
fields.help: Optional semicolon-separated ARM scope IDs for Azure Reader assignments. Blank means the selected subscription. Management-group scopes also cover descendant subscriptions; use narrower scopes when possible.

recommendationProfiles.title: Minimal pilot
recommendationProfiles.description: Disables the dashboard, Exchange, Teams, and Azure checks while keeping the Minimal profile's eight baseline managed-identity Graph application read roles. This still creates directory permission assignments. No email recipient is configured, so no Mail.Send grant is requested.

permissionChecks.name: Directory write authority requires operator review
permissionChecks.description: Directory read access cannot prove authority to assign application permissions, Entra roles, or delegated consent. Review the privileges required by your selected features before running the interactive hooks.

permissionChecks.name: Azure subscription access
permissionChecks.description: Azure CLI can complete a live ARM read of the selected enabled subscription in the selected tenant.

permissionChecks.name: Dashboard directory access
permissionChecks.description: Check Graph directory reachability for dashboard setup. This read does not prove application creation or delegated consent authority.
